entities.name: Reyav
entities.description: Dwarf artificer and sought-after smith of Avishkar, inventor of a multi-tool gauntlet.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Reyav demonstrated his shield attachment.

events.summary: Reyav makes his gauntlet designs public as a publicity stunt, and custom orders flood in.
events.quote: Reyav made the designs for the gauntlet publicly available.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Reyav demonstrates a portable energy shield, saving many from compleation.
events.quote: Reyav took the opportunity to demonstrate a portable energy shield attachment on his multi-tool gauntlet.
